testo:
■ At the start of your turn, put the top card of your deck into your graveyard.
■ Awaken—At the start of your turn, if there are 10 or more spells in your graveyard, return all cards in your graveyard to your deck and shuffle them, then flip this creature to its higher cost side.
Double Breaker
Hyperspatial Psychic
